mapper.select: SELECT id, permission_code, permission_name, parent_id, type, sort_order, deleted, created_at FROM sys_permission WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, permission_code, permission_name, parent_id, type, sort_order, deleted, created_at FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, permission_code, permission_name, parent_id, type, sort_order, deleted, created_at FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0

SELECT p.id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.parent_id, p.type, p.sort_order, p.deleted, p.created_at FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_code, permission_name, parent_id, type, sort_order) VALUES (#{permissionCode}, #{permissionName}, #{parentId}, #{type}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET permission_name = #{permissionName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, type = #{type}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_permission SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
